_comment: Grok. Save as ~/.grok/hooks/agent-observer.json (all sessions) or <project>/.grok/hooks/agent-observer.json (one project; run /hooks-trust). Replace AGENT_ID with the id configured in the web UI and the host with your device IP or agent-observer.local. Command hooks running curl via bash like the Claude Code ones (not "http" hooks: those POST the whole event, tool input included); Grok hooks fail open, so an unreachable device never blocks a tool call. The web UI generates this for you (Connect an agent). Hooks send only the event name, plus the tool name (tool/permission events) or the notification type (notifications), extracted locally from the hook JSON; the payload itself (prompts, tool input/output, paths, messages) is never sent.

hooks.command: v=$(grep -o '"tool_*[nN]ame" *: *"[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]*' | head -n 1 | sed 's/.*"//' | cut -c 1-40); curl -s -m 2 --connect-timeout 1 -X POST "http://agent-observer.local/api/hook/AGENT_ID?event=PreToolUse&tool=$v" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

v=$(grep -o '"tool_*[nN]ame" *: *"[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]*' | head -n 1 | sed 's/.*"//' | cut -c 1-40); curl -s -m 2 --connect-timeout 1 -X POST "http://agent-observer.local/api/hook/AGENT_ID?event=PermissionRequest&tool=$v" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

v=$(grep -o '"tool_*[nN]ame" *: *"[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]*' | head -n 1 | sed 's/.*"//' | cut -c 1-40); curl -s -m 2 --connect-timeout 1 -X POST "http://agent-observer.local/api/hook/AGENT_ID?event=PermissionDenied&tool=$v" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

v=$(grep -o '"notification_*[tT]ype" *: *"[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]*' | head -n 1 | sed 's/.*"//' | cut -c 1-40); curl -s -m 2 --connect-timeout 1 -X POST "http://agent-observer.local/api/hook/AGENT_ID?event=Notification&ntype=$v" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
